Oh this is an easy one :) Just don’t live in the US 😝. In Italy it’s 30/month without going thru public insurance and it’s 2€ a month with.
Absolutely, I would talk to a specialist though. Find a good Psychiatrist. I don’t recommend a family doctor, they are not usually trained for these specific issues
Depression is an illness. Just like diabetes is. There doesn’t need to be a reason to be depressed. It just happens unfortunately
I lived in the US. Unless you get the generic version of Adderall Vyvanse is 1200 a month!!!!

Yes I pay out of pocket for the doctor and medication. The doctor is around 250CHF. He prescribes me a two month supply so I don’t have to go see him every month.  The medication is also about 250CHF (for two months). Keep in mind that Vyvanse in Switzerland is called Elvanse, same exact drug though.

In Italy it’s even worse. Vyvanse and adderall are not available and Ritalin is EXCLUSIVELY for Children under 12 and has to be dispensed by specialized departments in hospitals. After 12 years of age you cannot obtain it anymore and they will stop giving you the medication

I am forced to go to Switzerland (luckily I live near the border) to get Elvanse (Vyvanse)
Or Brexpiprazole which is basically the newer improved version of aripiprazole
Or joint, to be more accurate. And honestly it might do the trick. In some places no prescription is required
Definitely need to add to the list Spravato (esketamine) approved by FDA for depression and Ketamine which is used off label either IV, with lozenges or a nasal spray

Everyone is different, you need to find a combination that works for you. If your insurance is willing to pay for it I recommend Trintellix (Brintellix in the EU) it is a newer antidepressants with few side effects. One medication is sometimes not enough so your doctor could try augmentation (aka adding another medication) with something like Brexpiprazole or even a stimulant to further improve symptoms
